title: Juicy Malaysian Chicken Noodles
description: Rich and flavorful dish featuring juicy chicken and crunchy vegetables, all in a low-glycemic and pressure-cooked sauce. A perfect weeknight dinner option.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish sauce, light soy sauce, and brown sugar to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until coated in the sauce, about 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, water chestnuts, and green onions to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are heated through.
Remove the noodles from the heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and serve on top of the noodles.
